KEGG pathway analysis of PFN‐1 and TAGLN‐2 enriched in regulation of actin cytoskeleton

KEGG pathway analysis of PFN‐1 and TAGLN‐2 enriched in regulation of actin cytoskeleton. TGNLN‐2 is also involved in actin polymerization therefore added additionally and highlighted with orange color
